name: Hand rises to face
text: She raises her right hand to her face.
desc: The classic reaction gesture - grief, exhaustion, realisation. Landed 9/9 in the probe across three seeds and three grammatical forms.
needs: a person in frame with a visible hand
verdict: RENDERED 2026-08-04, 3 seeds, watched at subject crop. Motion 0.571/0.725/0.561 - at or BELOW the empty control on every seed, and the gesture lands 3/3 anyway. Reproduces motion_probe's 9/9 result on a fourth independent seed set. The hand reaches the face by f38-f77 and the face survives on 7701 and 7703. WARNING: on 7702 she completes the gesture and then turns away by f96, so the shot does not end on her face 1/3. Band 0.406-0.744 (empty control 0.628); frame-scale ceiling 1.191.
